hypothesis: The authenticated v2 inventory definitively loses all source-owned support for 19 marker glyphs and 141 text glyphs under declared erosion because only axes and ticks receive a physically sufficient source width.
isolated_change: Widen the complete clean ink layer before the unchanged non-geometric degradation recipe. A shared source-only core preserves semantic target centers, radii and boxes; optional isolated-process element attribution never changes runtime pixels or reference annotations. Retain every source and failure; never retry, replace or filter a recipe.

audit_contract.attribution: Each exact per-element RGB layer retains its original color, grayscale and antialiasing through the same luma-sensitive degradation recipe; a separate binary mask measures clean support. Element layers are never composited into the runtime raster. Overlap with other ink cannot establish that a glyph is visibly distinct in the composite.
audit_contract.bounds: Semantic target boxes and clean renderer metadata remain unchanged in the source annotation. Attributed final bounds are separate audit fields and are null when the audit is ungraded.
audit_contract.topology: Report marker open-interior retention, element component counts, pairwise attributed overlaps and text hole-count changes. Morphological closing can fill counters in 0, 6, 8 or 9 even when dark support remains.
audit_contract.readability: Dark-pixel survival and unchanged topology do not establish text readability. Any definite erasure, lost open-marker interior or changed text counter topology remains a visible source failure; other overlap and readability limitations remain explicit diagnostics.
audit_contract.bounded_work: Gaussian, Poisson, impulse noise and paper texture run once in the shared physical source core. Per-element support, topology and overlap are explicitly ungraded/null for those stages; every marker/text remains in the inventory. This avoids hundreds of redundant full-canvas stochastic passes.
audit_contract.threading: The instrumented diagnostic API runs only in an isolated single-threaded process; shared processes use the source-only API.
audit_contract.source_only_parity: Source-only and audited paths share the same physical render core. Synthetic regressions compare exact RGB bytes, marker masks and annotations, including mask-conditioned outline/contact and stochastic recipes.

acceptance_bar: This is source-generation plumbing and diagnostic evidence only. It does not create a universal content-perfection gate. The existing 95 percent reviewable marker/OCR bars and zero silently exported unvalidated calibration runtime property remain unchanged.
